## reschedule_booking
Webhook Authentication = None. No fixed path or webhookId is exported. Use the URL n8n generates; if your import leaves Path blank, replace only the trigger with a fresh Webhook and reconnect it to Prepare reschedule (POST, Respond using Respond to Webhook node).

Standard request: POST {"booking_id":"UUID from get_bookings","date":"2026-11-03","time":"15-30"}. Time is HH-MM in 24-hour format, interpreted in Asia/Qyzylorda automatically. Select your ADMIN Bearer credential on Reschedule as primary host. Deploy the updated backend first.

Alternative: POST {"booking_id":"UUID from get_bookings","date":"2026-11-03","time":"15:00"}. Select an ADMIN Bearer credential on Reschedule as primary host to reschedule bookings across all specialists. Regular member credentials can reschedule only their own bookings. Deploy the updated Calnode backend first.

Exactly one of manage_url / booking_id. Supply date + time OR start_at with offset. timezone defaults to Asia/Qyzylorda. Existing specialist, answers and contacts are preserved. No appointments are cancelled/recreated.

The webhook is unauthenticated as requested. No credentials or private booking tokens are bundled. See reschedule-booking/README.md.
